notes.title: Demo version v0.1.02a update
notes.content:
Demo version v0.1.02a update fixes and optimization content:

About character:
[olist]
 The height of Sakura's main weapon (Swords) jumping after hitting in the air has been increased.
[/olist]

About levels:
[olist]
 Fixed the issue with the "GO tips display" error after completing the battle area.
[/olist]

About waiting room:
[olist]
 Added glowing effects to the starting position
 (Network Mode) Changed the waiting room to have at least 2 people before departure.
[/olist]

About description:
[olist]
 All descriptions of "Pickup" etc. buttons changed to "Stunt".
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo version v0.1.02 update
notes.content:
Demo version v0.1.02 update fixes and optimization content:

About character:
[olist]
 Ryder's secondary weapon: Slightly reduces the upward impact force of the rocket launcher when it hits the enemy.
 Fixed the issue where the character has a very low chance of getting stuck on the edge of a wall and unable to move after being knocked away.
 Optimized the left and right collision judgment when the character falls off the platform
[/olist]

About menu:
[olist]
 Pause menu: Added guidance UI for setting changes
 Pause menu: more concise and understandable button prompts
 Loading page: Change the prompt of "Loaded" to each language tips
[/olist]
